tooltip.essentialcraft5.calamity_remnant.en: What is left of a Heart of Calamity once it falls. Needed for the ninth matrix rank and the last attunement stages.
tooltip.essentialcraft5.calamity_remnant.zh: 天灾之心倒下以后留下的东西。九阶和最后几阶同调要用。

death.attack.essentialcraft5.calamity.en: %1$s didn't get out of the way of %2$s

death.attack.essentialcraft5.calamity.it.en: %1$s didn't get out of the way of %2$s using %3$s

death.attack.essentialcraft5.calamity.pl.en: %1$s was caught by a calamity whilst fighting %2$s

death.attack.essentialcraft5.calamity_so.en: %1$s was scorched by a burning sky whilst fighting %2$s

message.essentialcraft5.calamity_beacon..en: Only a real player can call it
Only players in Survival or Adventure can call it
message.essentialcraft5.calamity_beacon..zh: 只有生存或冒险模式下能召唤

message.essentialcraft5.calamity_beacon..en: The beacon only answers in Hoanna
message.essentialcraft5.calamity_beacon..zh: 信标只在海纳尔有回应

message.essentialcraft5.calamity_beacon..en: Your matrix rank is too low
The beacon needs a calamity raging in Hoanna right now
message.essentialcraft5.calamity_beacon..zh: 海纳尔此刻要有天灾，信标才有回应

message.essentialcraft5.calamity_beacon..en: Open sky is needed above the spot
The ground is too uneven here (%s blocks of height difference, at most %s)
message.essentialcraft5.calamity_beacon..zh: 这里地面太不平（高低差 %s 格，最多 %s 格）

message.essentialcraft5.calamity_beacon..en: You may not build here or where the pillars would stand
message.essentialcraft5.calamity_beacon..zh: 这里或灾柱落脚的地方你没有权限

message.essentialcraft5.calamity_beacon..en: Not sure about this spot yet. Try again in a moment
message.essentialcraft5.calamity_beacon..zh: 这里暂时判断不了，稍后再试

message.essentialcraft5.calamity_beacon..en: Another great foe is already within %s blocks
You have already brought down a Heart of Calamity today. Try again tomorrow
message.essentialcraft5.calamity_beacon..zh: 你今天已经打倒过天灾之心了，明天再来

message.essentialcraft5.calamity_beacon..en: A Heart of Calamity you summoned is still out there. Finish that fight first
message.essentialcraft5.calamity_beacon..zh: 你召出的天灾之心还在，先把那一场打完
要 %s 个暗影核心，你有 %s 个

message.essentialcraft5.calamity_beacon..en: There is no room above the spot
The summoning failed. Nothing was used
The Heart of Calamity descends, bearing %s (%s Shade Cores used)
message.essentialcraft5.calamity_beacon..zh: 天灾之心降临，主灾：%s（用掉 %s 个暗影核心）

message.essentialcraft5.calamity_heart.s.en: The pillars rise again. The Heart is shielded
message.essentialcraft5.calamity_heart.s.zh: 灾柱重新立起，天灾之心又被护住了

message.essentialcraft5.calamity_heart.s.en: A pillar falls. The Heart is open for a moment
message.essentialcraft5.calamity_heart.s.zh: 一根灾柱倒下，天灾之心露出了破绽

message.essentialcraft5.calamity_heart.f.en: The Heart of Calamity fades away

message.essentialcraft5.calamity_heart.d.en: The Heart of Calamity is defeated

message.essentialcraft5.calamity_heart.m.en: The sun marks you. Get under cover
message.essentialcraft5.calamity_heart.m.zh: 烈日盯上了你，快躲到方块下面

message.essentialcraft5.calamity_heart.b.en: Darkness falls. Hold a light to see it
message.essentialcraft5.calamity_heart.b.zh: 黑暗降临，拿着光源才看得见它

message.essentialcraft5.calamity_heart.e.en: Echo: Noon. Get out of the open sky
Echo: Fault lines. Jump the waves

message.essentialcraft5.calamity_heart.f.en: You fell, and the Heart of Calamity fades
message.essentialcraft5.calamity_heart.f.zh: 你倒下了，天灾之心随之散去

message.essentialcraft5.calamity_heart.f.en: You left, and the Heart of Calamity fades
message.essentialcraft5.calamity_heart.f.zh: 你离开了，天灾之心随之散去

message.essentialcraft5.calamity_heart.f.en: You left this world, and the Heart of Calamity fades
message.essentialcraft5.calamity_heart.f.zh: 你离开了这个世界，天灾之心随之散去

message.essentialcraft5.calamity_heart.f.en: No one is left to fight it, and the Heart of Calamity fades
message.essentialcraft5.calamity_heart.f.zh: 没人再和它交手，天灾之心散去了

message.essentialcraft5.calamity_heart.f.en: On Peaceful, the Heart of Calamity fades
message.essentialcraft5.calamity_heart.f.zh: 和平难度下，天灾之心散去了

message.essentialcraft5.calamity_heart.f.en: The Heart of Calamity fell to no one
message.essentialcraft5.calamity_heart.f.zh: 天灾之心不是被参战的人打倒的

message.essentialcraft5.calamity_heart.f.en: The calamity pillars could not rise here, and the Heart of Calamity fades
message.essentialcraft5.calamity_heart.f.zh: 灾柱在这里立不起来，天灾之心散去了

message.essentialcraft5.calamity_heart.r.en: Your beacon is returned as it was, with the %s Shade Cores you spent
message.essentialcraft5.calamity_heart.r.zh: 信标原样退回，连同用掉的 %s 个暗影核心

message.essentialcraft5.calamity_heart.r.en: Your beacon and the %s Shade Cores you spent will be returned when you are back
message.essentialcraft5.calamity_heart.r.zh: 信标和用掉的 %s 个暗影核心会在你回来时退回

message.essentialcraft5.calamity_heart.b.en: Your beacon is returned, spent. Calling it again takes Shade Cores
message.essentialcraft5.calamity_heart.b.zh: 信标回到你手里，已经空了，再召要暗影核心

message.essentialcraft5.calamity_heart.b.en: Your spent beacon will be returned when you are back
message.essentialcraft5.calamity_heart.b.zh: 空了的信标会在你回来时还给你

message.essentialcraft5.calamity_heart.d.en: Items from %s Heart of Calamity summonings were returned to you
message.essentialcraft5.calamity_heart.d.zh: %s 次天灾之心召唤的东西还给你了

message.essentialcraft5.calamity_heart.h.en: Your beacon and items from the Heart of Calamity are returned
message.essentialcraft5.calamity_heart.h.zh: 天灾之心那边的信标和东西还给你了

message.essentialcraft5.calamity_heart.s.en: Your enchantments are sealed by the calamity. Bring down the pillars to free them
message.essentialcraft5.calamity_heart.s.zh: 你的附魔被天灾封印了——打倒灾柱逐一解开

message.essentialcraft5.calamity_seal.un.en: Helmet and chestplate enchantments work again
message.essentialcraft5.calamity_seal.un.zh: 头盔、胸甲的附魔解开了

message.essentialcraft5.calamity_seal.un.en: Leggings and boots enchantments work again
message.essentialcraft5.calamity_seal.un.zh: 护腿、靴子的附魔解开了

message.essentialcraft5.calamity_seal.un.en: Off hand, curio and inventory enchantments work again
message.essentialcraft5.calamity_seal.un.zh: 副手、饰品栏和背包里的附魔解开了

tooltip.essentialcraft5.calamity_seal.en: Calamity Seal: bring down the %s Pillar to free it
tooltip.essentialcraft5.calamity_seal.zh: 天灾封印：打倒%s灾柱解开

tooltip.essentialcraft5.calamity_seal.hi.en: The enchantments above do nothing in this fight until freed
tooltip.essentialcraft5.calamity_seal.hi.zh: 上面列的附魔在这场战斗里解开之前不生效

banner.essentialcraft5.calamity_heart.un.en: Every pillar has fallen. The Heart loses its balance
banner.essentialcraft5.calamity_heart.un.zh: 灾柱全倒，天灾之心失衡了

banner.essentialcraft5.calamity_heart.co.en: Every pillar has fallen. Get inside the golden circle around it
banner.essentialcraft5.calamity_heart.co.zh: 灾柱全倒——快进它身边的金圈

banner.essentialcraft5.calamity_heart.co.en: Finish it before it bursts. It still lashes out
banner.essentialcraft5.calamity_heart.co.zh: 趁它爆发前打倒它，它还会垂死反扑

banner.essentialcraft5.calamity_heart.re.en: The Heart raises two pillars and pulls itself together
banner.essentialcraft5.calamity_heart.re.zh: 天灾之心立起两根灾柱，重新凝聚

banner.essentialcraft5.calamity_heart.un.en: The Heart is coming apart and will not stop
banner.essentialcraft5.calamity_heart.un.zh: 天灾之心彻底失控，不会再停下

banner.essentialcraft5.calamity_heart.de.en: The Heart of Calamity is defeated

banner.essentialcraft5.calamity_heart.co.en: Stand between the prism lines and stay out of the fumes
banner.essentialcraft5.calamity_heart.co.zh: 站在两道棱线之间，别进毒雾

banner.essentialcraft5.calamity_heart.co.en: Hold a light and watch for the shadows of falling rubble
banner.essentialcraft5.calamity_heart.co.zh: 拿着光源，看清落石的影子

banner.essentialcraft5.calamity_heart.co.en: Hold a light to see the strikes. Each one leaves fumes behind
banner.essentialcraft5.calamity_heart.co.zh: 拿着光源看清暗袭，落点会留下毒雾

banner.essentialcraft5.calamity_heart.co.en: Jump the waves while standing between the prism lines
banner.essentialcraft5.calamity_heart.co.zh: 跳过震波，同时站在两道棱线之间

tooltip.essentialcraft5.calamity_beacon..en: Use on the ground in Hoanna to call the Heart of Calamity
tooltip.essentialcraft5.calamity_beacon..zh: 在海纳尔对着地面使用，召唤天灾之心

tooltip.essentialcraft5.calamity_beacon..en: Needs: Matrix %1$s, a calamity raging, open sky, flat ground
tooltip.essentialcraft5.calamity_beacon..zh: 需要：矩阵%1$s、此刻有天灾、露天、平地

tooltip.essentialcraft5.calamity_beacon..en: Needs: Matrix %1$s, open sky, flat ground
Needs: a calamity raging, open sky, flat ground
tooltip.essentialcraft5.calamity_beacon..zh: 需要：此刻有天灾、露天、平地
满的：召唤要 %s 个暗影核心
空的：召唤要 %s 个暗影核心

tooltip.essentialcraft5.calamity_beacon..en: If the Heart is not defeated, the beacon and cores come back
tooltip.essentialcraft5.calamity_beacon..zh: 没打倒的话，信标和核心原样退回
